evidence.title: Agetor README
evidence.locator: Features; Supported harnesses; Install; Pipelines; Command-line interface; Keep Agetor running; How it works; Configuration; Security model; Roadmap
evidence.finding: Local-first kanban orchestrator (Electrobun macOS app on Apple Silicon plus agetor CLI/headless daemon) running Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, fx, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode in per-task git worktrees; pipelines of Agents; no account, no cloud relay, no telemetry; MIT.

evidence.title: Agetor README: Security model
evidence.finding: Agents run with your full user privileges and Agetor adds no sandbox; API binds to 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch random token; untrusted issue text is labelled; only network calls are update checks, configured git hosts and harness quota lookups.

evidence.title: Agetor README: Roadmap
evidence.finding: Roadmap lists Linux and Windows builds (targets configured, not built or tested), graduating experimental harnesses to stable, and more harnesses; no dates.

evidence.title: Task lifecycle
evidence.finding: POST /tasks creates a backlog row with worktree isolation by default and pins the base ref sha; startTask runs pre-flight checks (agent on PATH, minimum CLI version) then launches; boot reconciliation moves runs whose session is gone back to Ready.

evidence.title: Always-on host
evidence.finding: Optional macOS login-item supervisor keeps a never-idle core running with the app closed and hands back to the app on launch; remote access is preview only.

evidence.title: Harness stacks
evidence.finding: Ordered stacks of same-harness accounts fail over to a backup when the primary hits a usage or rate limit, with cooldown rows per harness and model.

evidence.title: Issue tasks
evidence.finding: Tasks can be seeded from GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket issue threads via git-host APIs.
